limitations: This supports the sufficient block theorem. It does not show that a specified high-dimensional learner meets the prediction conditions under drift, or extend the conclusion to dependent evaluation blocks or weak residual information. The bounded-fit premise is a fixed uniform envelope over sample sizes and laws, obtainable by clipping fits to the known nuisance bounds.
